name: geno-2
description: Geno-2: generative audiovisual instrument built with Rust, WebAssembly, WebGPU, and WebAudio

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && node scripts/gen-env.js && npm run assemble && npm run verify:build
scripts.ci: npm run build && (http-server -p 8080 -c-1 dist >/dev/null 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; node web-test.js)
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-targets
scripts.check: npm run check:rust && npm run check:js && npm run check:diagrams && npm run ci
scripts.nuke: rm -rf .wrangler node_modules package-lock.json && npm install && npm run dev
